bins.description: Skip assembly and binning. Provide a directory with assembled bins fasta files and readcount file.
bins.help_text: This entrypoint allows you to skip the binning step of the pipeline. You can provide already subsampled reads with --fastqs and thereby skip subsampling using --subsample false. Provide the path to a directory with all the bins you want to use. This entry-point also requires that you provide a readcount file for the samples you want to use. See --readcount -help for format.

readcount.description: A tab-delimited file with sample name and total reads (all fastqs combined)
readcount.help_text:
E.g.
Sample Total_reads
Sample1 1000000
Sample2 2000000
etc. for each sample
Make sure the headers are correct!

only_bins.description: Stops the pipeline after binning. Can only be used in Entrypoint 1.
only_bins.help_text: It is possible to stop the pipeline after binning, meaning that only assembly, binning and subsampling is run for your input data. By default this parameter is set to false, but by adding --only_bins to the nextflow run command it becomes true.

ref_genome.description: Path to a fasta file that you want to do variant calling with
ref_genome.help_text:
--ref_genome path/to/fasta/file
This will only run the variant calling workflow (Bowtie2, Freebayes, POGENOM) for the specified reference genome. Can be used with --contigs to only check specified contigs for diversity. Only one genome allowed.

contigs.help_text: A tsv with contig names and length, named <ref_genome.contigs.tsv> specifying the contigs you're interested in SNP analysis for.
contigs.description: A TSV with contig names that you want to use for variant calling. If not provided will use whole reference fasta genome when starting from ref_genome. Otherwise ignored.

bintables.description: A directory with at least one .bintable file in it. For the bin entry point only. For bins with taxonomic classification and quality scores (checkM2) the pipeline won't re-run those steps.
bintables.help_text: A directory with .bintables files that can be provided for the pre-existing bins entrypoint. These should follow the formatting of the bintables output by the pipeline. In other words, a tab-delimited file with the columns: Bin ID  Completeness    Contamination   Tax GTDB-Tk.

run_VC.description: If false stops the pipeline after assembling pangenomes.
run_VC.help_text: This parameter can be set to false to stop the pipeline after assembling pangenomes and mapping subsampled reads. Can be useful for running the pipeline in steps, and only with pangenomes of interest.

nr_samps_threshold.description: Minimum number of matching samples for a pangenome to be considered for further analysis
nr_samps_threshold.help_text: The minimum number of samples with good average expected coverage for a pangenome to be used for downstream analysis.

block_size.description: Controls the RAM-usage for DIAMOND when read mapping.
block_size.help_text: The pipeline runs DIAMOND via SqueezeMeta for functional identification of genes in the ref-/pangenome. This can require a lot of memory and temporary disk space. To limit this you can set the block size to what best fits your system. See the [DIAMOND](https://github.com/bbuchfink/diamond/wiki/3.-Command-line-options#memory--performance-options) and (SqueezeMeta)[https://github.com/jtamames/SqueezeMeta?tab=readme-ov-file#working-in-a-low-memory-environment) documentations for details.

nr_subsamp.description: Number of reads to be subsampled from the raw fastq files
nr_subsamp.help_text: You can modify how many reads should be subsampled to then be used for mapping against the pangenomes/reference genomes to determine which samples have good coverage for that genome.

min_contig_len.description: Minimum length of contigs used for variant calling.
min_contig_len.help_text: By default, the minimum length of contigs used for variant calling are at least a 1000 bases. This parameter sets the minimum length to whatever you want.

pipeline_parameters.title: Pipeline parameters

project.help_text: The name of your project. Creates a directory with this name, where results will be stored

samples.help_text: A tab-separated file with sample names in column 1, fastq file names in column 2 and readpair in column 3.

fastq.help_text: The path to the directory containing the raw fastq reads
fastq.description: Fastq file directory with raw reads for all samples

threads.help_text: Assign how many threads the pipeline can use at a time

pipeline_parameters.help_text: Input always required for running the pipeline.

motu_creation.title: mOTU creation
motu_creation.description: Settings for mOTUlizer and taxonomy parser

MAGcomplete.description: Min. completeness of high quality MAGs
MAGcomplete.help_text: Decides which bins/genomes are used to build the mOTU in mOTUlizer. Lower quality bins can still be recruited to mOTUs.

MAGcontam.description: Max. contamination of high quality MAGs
MAGcontam.help_text: Decides which bins/genomes are used to build the mOTU in mOTUlizer. Lower quality bins can still be recruited to mOTUs.

min_mOTU_MAGs.description: Minimum amount of MAGs necessary for a mOTU to be used for further analysis
min_mOTU_MAGs.help_text:
Sets how many genomes need to be part of the same mOTU for that mOTU to get it's own directory in the results mOTUs directory and to be used for pangenome analysis.
This parameter currently takes the sum of MAGs and SUBs to a mOTU.

taxSort.description: Decides wich way to sort bins before clustering. By default splits clustering into several jobs based on initial taxonomix classification, which might mean that some unclassified bins are dropped at this stage. For options see --help taxSort.
taxSort.help_text:
Options:
root: sends all bins to the clustering tool together.
auto: finds the lowest taxonomic rank where at least 90% of bins have been given a classification.
Possible taxonomic ranks: domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus and species.
Default behaviour, auto, divides the clustering into several jobs which makes computation easier, but you might lose out on some unclassified bins for your pangenome. If you believe you have enough computational resources root will lead to one job of clustering that scales quadratically depending on the number of bins. This method is more likely to find which species/pangenome an unclassified bin belongs to.

subsample.description: Whether to subsample the raw reads or not.
subsample.help_text: Setting --subsample false means that the full raw reads will be used for checking which samples have good coverage over which pangenomes. Using the default of --subsample true is recommended, especially with many samples since that will save a lot of computation time.

force_variant_calling.description: Run variant calling and Pogenom even when subsampling is skipped
force_variant_calling.help_text: Default behaviour is to not run the variant calling workflow when skipping subsampling. This parameter allows that to be bypassed, meaning that read mapping each sample to each pangenome/reference genome might take a very long time and use a lot of resources.

binners.description: Choose which binners to use when assembling
binners.help_text: Options are maxbin, metabat2 and concoct. By default the pipeline combines the results of all three. To use just one write --binners <tool>

contig_len.description: Minimum length of contigs to be used for assembly
contig_len.help_text: By default only contigs that are at least 2500 bases long are used for variant calling. This parameter lets you set the minimum length to a chosen number.

min_locus_cov.description: Minimum coverage required for a specific locus to be used for diversity analysis.
min_locus_cov.help_text: Used for running POGENOM in calc_pang_div. If a locus has too low coverage it won't be included for that sample.

min_cov.description: Minimum coverage for a sample to be used for variant calling to a pangenome
min_cov.help_text: Used for estimating average coverage of subsampled reads to a pan-/reference genome and median coverage of mapped reads to core/contigs over min_contig_length. This determines how much coverage is required for a sample to a genome to be used for variant calling.

min_breadth.description: Minimum breadth required over core/selected contigs for a sample to be used for cariant calling
min_breadth.help_text: Breadth is based on the alignment of all of a samples reads to a pangenome. Samples that pass the median coverage and breadth checks will be downsampled for even coverage between samples, and used to analyse variants within a pangenome.

help.help_text: Information on how to use the pipeline
